Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing faith communities to host temporary homeless encampments subject to restrictions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to homeless tent encampments; and adding a newsection to chapter 43.185C RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.185CRCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Due to concerns about maintaining freedom of religious expression,faith communities shall not be restricted from hosting temporaryencampments for the homeless. A temporary encampment may be subject toreasonable compliance requirements related to public health and safety.However, no local government shall set less than ninety days as themaximum duration for homeless encampments.
